instruction: Use command-line automation through the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment and CAMWorks API; do not use GUI clicks, generic G-code generators, or manual .nc editing/copying. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\risky_setup.step and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv. Treat the fixture solids contained in the supplied STEP assembly as the complete collision envelope for this task; installed TechDB holder profiles may be used to instantiate tools but must not change the required safe-hole set. Plan spot-drilling and drilling for the sixteen D5 candidate holes with the supplied D3 spot drill and D5 drill while maintaining at least 3 mm radial clearance between the cutting-tool envelope and every fixture during cutting or lateral feed motion. The holes centered at (-45, 24), (15, 24), and (45, 24) mm do not satisfy this clearance and must be skipped; omit those three coordinates from cutting cycles. Spot-drill and drill all remaining thirteen holes, use a clearance plane at least 3 mm above the 28 mm fixture tops for lateral positioning, and post the result through SOLIDWORKS CAM. Save the posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-15.nc.
